label: July 6–12
title: “There Is a Prophet in Israel” —  2 Kings 2

items.text: A prophet’s main mission is to teach and testify of the Savior Jesus Christ. While Elisha’s record emphasizes miracles, these powerful manifestations of the Lord’s life-giving, nourishing, and healing power do testify of Christ. Miracles happen more often than we realize if we seek the faith to see them.

Miracles show us God’s power and can help us overcome life’s difficulties. As we read the accounts of Elisha, we can ponder the spiritual lessons learned from each miracle and consider how they turn us to the Lord. Comparing these miracles with those of Jesus Christ teaches us about the Savior and His prophets.

The Lord inspired Elisha to prophesy of things to come, often things that seemed unlikely. As we consider the word of the Lord through His prophets today, we must ask ourselves how we respond to their teachings and prophecies. Acting in faith on their words is essential to receiving the Lord’s promises.

As we are humble and obedient, Jesus Christ can heal us. Even simple invitations from the Lord, like Naaman’s command to 'wash, and be clean,' can lead to profound healing. We should consider what might be keeping us from accepting His simple invitations and how we can show humility.

Elisha’s ministry and miracles, though not always direct teachings about Christ, powerfully testify of Him. They are manifestations of the Lord’s power to give life, nourish, and heal. To see these miracles in our lives, we need to cultivate the faith Elisha demonstrated when he prayed for his servant’s eyes to be opened.

Comparing physical elements in scripture stories with spiritual matters in our own lives can reveal personal meaning. Situations like leprosy, a borrowed ax, the Jordan River, or an invading army can teach us valuable lessons from the Lord when we apply them to our own circumstances.

The Lord can work miracles in our lives. These miracles can help us navigate challenges and, most importantly, turn our hearts to Him. By seeking and expecting miracles, we open ourselves to God’s power and His divine intervention in our lives, strengthening our faith.

Naaman’s experience teaches us how humility and obedience can lead to healing through Jesus Christ. His faith in the God of Israel grew as he followed the prophet’s simple instruction. We too can experience spiritual cleansing and healing by heeding the counsel of prophets and the Savior.

The miracles performed by Elisha, such as raising a child from the dead, feeding a multitude, and healing a leper, all serve as testaments to the Savior’s power. These events highlight Christ’s ability to bring life, sustenance, and healing, reminding us of His divine love and compassion for all.

We must ask ourselves how we respond to the word of the Lord given through His prophets today. What teachings and prophecies have we heard? What are we doing to act in faith on their words? The Lord will fulfill His promises, but our faith and obedience are crucial.
